Products Solutions Support Training Resources Partners Corporate Explore Careers at Fortinet sitemap Profile Sign Out View More Jobs Applied AI Agent Sunnyvale, CA, United States 0 --> Trending Job Info Job Identification 22125 Job Category Machine Learning Posting Date 08/12/2026, 01:18 PM Locations Sunnyvale, CA, United States Job Schedule Full time Job Description We are a cybersecurity company building a next-generation AI-driven operations platform, designed to power complex, high-stakes workflows. Our product integrates generative AI deeply into real-time operational environments—combining reasoning, retrieval, and automation into scalable, trustworthy systems. The Opportunity We’re looking for ambitious undergraduate new graduates with a strong foundation in computer science and a genuine interest in AI to join us as an Applied AI Engineer. This is an ideal role for someone who has built projects, completed internships, or pursued coursework in backend systems and applied AI—and is ready to grow those skills in a fast-paced production environment. You’ll work alongside senior engineers, product managers, and AI researchers to build systems that drive investigation speed, streamline operations, and unlock new modes of human-AI collaboration. What You’ll Do Development • Build and maintain backend services and AI-integrated features for real-time, high-volume operational workloads. • Integrate LLMs and GenAI components into production workflows, including prompt orchestration, retrieval pipelines, and evaluation loops. • Help design data flows (event streams, message queues, job orchestration) to support next-generation SOC/NOC capabilities. • Write clean, well-documented code with clear API contracts between AI services, backend APIs, and frontend clients. • Contribute to trustworthy AI delivery: streaming responses, structured outputs, redaction/guardrails, and human-in-the-loop review. Collaboration • Work with senior backend engineers to build data pipelines that power AI-driven features. • Collaborate with design and frontend engineers to translate complex backend/AI systems into intuitive user experiences. • Participate in code reviews, technical design discussions, and team retrospectives. • Communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical teammates about progress, blockers, and trade-offs. Who You Are Education • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, AI/ML, or a closely related technical field (graduated within the past 6 months or graduating by Summer 2026). Technical Skills Core Backend Platform • Proficiency in at least one modern backend language (e.g., Python, Go) demonstrated through coursework, personal projects, or internships. • Familiarity with API design (REST, WebSocket, or GraphQL) and basic understanding of event-driven or real-time systems. • Coursework or hands-on exposure to relational databases (e.g., Postgres) and data modeling fundamentals. • Basic understanding of authentication/authorization patterns and web application security. • Awareness of distributed systems concepts (load balancing, caching, message queues). AI/ML Foundations • Completed coursework or projects involving machine learning, NLP, or deep learning. • Familiarity with AI/ML frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow, Hugging Face) from class or personal projects. • Interest in or exposure to LLM-based applications, prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation and agentic system design • Enthusiasm for learning about multi-agent architectures, fine-tuning workflows, and evaluation techniques. Communication Soft Skills • Strong problem-solving skills and intellectual curiosity. • Excellent written and verbal communication skills. • Eagerness to learn quickly, take feedback constructively, and grow in a team environment. • Experience working on team-based projects (class projects, hackathons, clubs, or open-source contributions). What Sets You Apart • Internship experience at a tech, cybersecurity, or AI company. • Personal projects demonstrating end-to-end application development (especially with LLM integrations). • Contributions to open-source projects in AI/ML, developer tools, or backend frameworks. • Participation in hackathons, programming competitions, or CTF (Capture the Flag) events. • A standout capstone or senior thesis project related to AI systems or distributed computing. What We Offer • A structured onboarding experience with mentorship from senior engineers and researchers. • Opportunity to shape the future of AI-assisted cybersecurity and operations at scale. • Real ownership of product features used daily by enterprise customers—not busywork. • Continuous learning in AI/ML, distributed systems, and modern web technologies. • Comprehensive benefits including medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance, 401(k), 11 paid holidays, vacation time, and sick time. Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without sponsorship. The US base salary range for this full-time position is $179,500–$220,000. Exact salary offers will be determined by factors such as skill level, qualifications, academic achievements, and geographic location. All roles are eligible to participate in the Fortinet equity program. Bonus eligibility is reviewed at the time of hire and annually at the company’s discretion. About Us Fortinet (NASDAQ: FTNT) secures the largest enterprise, service provider, and government organizations around the world. Fortinet empowers its customers with intelligent, seamless protection across the expanding attack surface and the power to take on ever-increasing performance requirements of the borderless network - today and into the future. Only the Fortinet Security Fabric architecture can deliver security without compromise to address the most critical security challenges, whether in networked, application, cloud or mobile environments. f5d0810b-8d0e-4bee-b85c-e93f19ab3aef.title: Software Engineer - Datapath
f5d0810b-8d0e-4bee-b85c-e93f19ab3aef.description: BambooHR Privacy Policy Job Openings Software Engineer - Datapath Engineering - R D - San Jose, California (Hybrid) SOFTWARE ENGINEER - DATAPATH Turn a customer’s intent into a live, multi-cloud network — automatically, anywhere in the world — and learn the entire stack while you do it. THE MISSION When a company connects its data centers, clouds, and offices on Alkira , our team is what makes it happen. The customer tells us what they want — connect these networks, across these clouds, with these policies — and we turn that into a real, working network in minutes instead of weeks, automatically. We’re the Playbooks / Orchestration team, and we build that automation. Using a mix of Ansible, Python, and Go, we set up the networking stack on our Cloud Exchange Points (CXPs) and run the workflows that keep it healthy — including tricky operations like safely restarting a node. We bring up new virtual network functions (VNFs), build the tooling and CLI used to inspect and configure each node, and work closely with the Routing, Data Path, and Backend teams. Our team spans the US and India, and above all we make sure every customer network comes up correctly and reliably, across every cloud. LOCATION: This is a hybrid work environment that requires onsite at San Jose, CA HQ on Tuesdays and Thursdays WHAT YOU’LL WORK ON Automate the cloud. Write the Ansible playbooks that provision infrastructure and stand up network services across AWS, Azure, and GCP — VPCs/VNets, subnets, tunnels, NAT, routing, and security policy. Build the engines. Develop the Go task engines that push this configuration onto the CXP nodes at scale — running provisioning and teardown against live state, and rebuilding a node’s entire configuration after a controlled restart. Bring up new capabilities. Integrate new VNFs as we light up new services and capabilities. Own the tooling. Build the Python tooling and CLI engineers use to inspect, configure, and debug the networking stack on the nodes. Model the work. Extend the configuration and task models that translate a single provisioning request into the exact commands applied on the nodes. Keep it fast and correct. Help connectivity stay correct, fast, and reliable across clouds and at scale. Solve real problems. Chase tricky production provisioning issues to their root cause and drive the fix — and collaborate with Routing, Data Path, and Backend on how configuration flows end to end. You won’t touch all of this on day one. Most engineers start in one layer and grow outward fast. WHO YOU ARE We’re looking for a well-rounded Software Engineer with a basic grounding in networking technologies. Our stack spans several layers — Ansible playbooks, Go task engines, Python tooling, the networking stack on the nodes — and sits right next to the C-based data path. You don’t need to be an expert in all of it. Bring strong fundamentals and real curiosity about how networks and clouds work, and you’ll start in one layer and grow into the rest. You'll thrive here if you have: Strong software fundamentals — data structures, problem-solving, clean code, and the patience to debug. Hands-on coding in at least one of C, Python, or Go, and the appetite to pick up the others — we use all three everyday, and the engineers who range across them go furthest. Comfort on Linux — the shell, processes, logs, and the everyday networking tools. Hands-on familiarity with core networking — TCP/IP, and the curiosity to go deeper. A working mental model of the cloud — at least one of AWS, Azure, or GCP: what a VPC/VNet, subnet, and security group actually are. A debugging mindset — you genuinely enjoy chasing a problem until you find the real cause. Bonus Points Ansible or other configuration-automation experience. You use AI-assisted development tools like Claude Code — we lean on them to build workflows, write debug tooling, and move faster across the entire software development lifecycle. Experience building CLIs, task runners, or automation that runs at scale. Familiarity with firewalls, load balancers, and similar network services. WHY YOU’LL GROW FAST HERE The orchestration layer touches every part of the system — clouds, Linux, the networking stack, and the data path next door. That makes it one of the best vantage points in the company for an early-career engineer: you’ll get unusually broad exposure, work shoulder-to-shoulder with networking and systems experts, and build a deep, end-to-end picture of how a real cloud network works. Strong all-rounders here don’t stay in one lane — they move fluidly between layers and become the people who understand how the whole thing fits together. ON-CALL On-call is a mandatory part of this role. You’ll join the orchestration on-call rotation and help debug and resolve production provisioning issues, with coverage coordinated across the US and India. It’s also where a lot of the deepest learning happens — there’s no faster way to understand a system than to keep it running. ABOUT ALKIRA Alkira, a Lumen company , is building the future of enterprise networking: one programmable platform to connect, secure, and operate every cloud, site, partner, data center, and AI workload. Founded by Amir and Atif Khan, the creators of Viptela and pioneers of the SD-WAN market, Alkira was built to radically simplify how enterprises deploy and manage network infrastructure. Today, as part of Lumen, we are bringing that cloud-native operating model to a global network foundation trusted by the world’s largest enterprises. Our platform helps customers move faster without managing hardware, stitching together providers, or operating fragmented cloud networks. Teams can build and scale connectivity on demand, apply consistent security and segmentation, and gain visibility across distributed environments from one place. At Alkira, you’ll help shape the next chapter of networking: cloud-like consumption, private-network performance, and total control across the enterprise. We move

Meet the Team Join a team dedicated to performing failure analysis and debug of transceiver and optical engine multi-chip modules. Working closely with failure analysis engineers and cross-functional partners, the team investigates customer-reported issues, identifies root causes, and continuously improves failure analysis methods, processes, and reporting. The team's focus is on increasing the accuracy, speed, and efficiency of failure analysis while delivering a high-quality customer experience. Your Impact As a Failure Analysis Engineer, you will perform hands-on debug and failure analysis of transceiver products and optical engine components to identify root causes and drive corrective actions. You will replicate customer-reported failures, document technical findings, and contribute to customer-facing reports. By collaborating across teams and using data to improve failure analysis processes, you will help increase operational efficiency, reduce future failures, and enhance the quality and timeliness of customer support. Minimum Qualifications Completion within the past 3 years, or current enrollment with expected completion within 12 months, of a certification or relevant degree program (e.g., Associates, Apprenticeship, Boot Camp, or Certification in a specialized program + 1 year of relevant experience, High School Diploma + 2 years of relevant experience) or Bachelors + 0 years of relevant experience. Experience in failure analysis or sustaining engineering for high bit rate coherent optical transceivers, line cards, and/or terminal equipment. Experience performing hands-on debug and failure analysis using electronic and optical test equipment. Understanding of coherent transceiver products, electronic and RF circuits, optical/RF components, and optical transmission test methodologies. Experience documenting technical findings and performing data analysis to determine root cause. Ability to collaborate effectively in a fast-paced environment while taking ownership of technical issues. Preferred Qualifications Familiarity with the application of coherent transceivers in optical networks. Strong failure analysis techniques at the subsystem, component, and device levels. Experience using oscilloscopes, pattern generators/error detectors, and electrical and optical spectrum analyzers. Experience using data and metrics to improve failure analysis efficiency and reporting quality. Strong documentation and technical reporting skills. Why Cisco? At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint. Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. We are Cisco, and our power starts with you. From Kettle’s bold crunch to Rowse’s natural sweetness, through to Matthew Walker and Barratt Sweets, our portfolio blends heritage, craft and category-leading innovation. Alongside our branded portfolio, we are also one of the UK’s largest suppliers of private label products, partnering with major retailers to deliver quality and category expertise that meets the needs of millions of households every week. Job Description We're looking for a motivated and enthusiastic Enterprise Applications Developer to join our growing IT team. This is an exciting opportunity to gain hands-on experience developing business-critical applications, enhancing enterprise systems, and working with modern Microsoft technologies within a supportive environment. Work with business users to understand requirements and deliver practical technical solutions. Assist with system integrations and API development. Collaborate with colleagues across the business and provide technical guidance where appropriate. Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives that enhance business processes. Follow development standards, version control, and best practices using Git. Field Service Engineers London/South East Full-time Compensation: GBP 35,000 - GBP 41,000 - yearly Company Description TOMRA is a global leader in recycling and circular economy solutions. Founded in 1972, we design and deliver technology that helps keep valuable materials in circulation and reduces waste worldwide. With over 5,500 employees globally and operations in 60+ markets, TOMRA is now entering a major growth phase in the UK ahead of the planned Deposit Return Scheme launch in 2027. This is a unique opportunity to join the UK organisation as it scales and help build the teams that will support the next generation of recycling infrastructure. Job Description As a Field Engineer, you’ll play a vital role in supporting TOMRA’s mission to transform the way the world recycles—while always putting safety first. Whether working with equipment, customers, or travelling between sites, you’ll operate in a safety-focused environment where the wellbeing of our people and customers is a top priority. You’ll help keep our technology running smoothly by maintaining, repairing, and optimising equipment at customer sites. This is a hands-on, early-career role with a mix of planned and reactive work, offering variety, autonomy, and strong opportunities to learn and grow in a supportive team environment. You’ll be a key part of delivering a great customer experience while building your technical expertise. As the UK prepares for the introduction of the Deposit Return Scheme (DRS), TOMRA is entering an exciting growth phase and we're now looking for Field Service Engineers across London and the South East. What You’ll Be Doing As a Field Engineer, no two days are the same. You'll spend your time supporting customers, troubleshooting equipment, carrying out maintenance, and helping install new recycling technology. Working closely with experienced colleagues, you'll build your technical expertise while playing a key role in delivering an excellent customer experience and ensuring our equipment operates safely and reliably. Install, maintain, and repair TOMRA Reverse Vending Machines (RVMs) at customer sites. Support the installation, commissioning, and roll-out of new machines as TOMRA expands across the UK. Diagnose and resolve mechanical and electrical issues, carrying out both preventative maintenance and reactive repairs. Build strong relationships with customers and site contacts, providing professional and friendly service. Travel throughout your region to support customers, with occasional overnight stays when required. Accurately record service activities, machine status, and updates using digital systems and tools. Contribute to continuous improvement by sharing feedback, developing your technical knowledge, and maintaining high safety standards at all times. Ways of Working You'll follow established safety procedures, including TOMRA Safe and LOTO standards. You'll be supported with training, tools, and a collaborative team culture. Flexibility is essential in this role, as occasional approved overtime and weekend working will be required to support business needs. From October 2027, the position will transition to a rota-based shift pattern, which will include weekend coverage. Why This Role Is Exciting With the UK Deposit Return Scheme launching in October 2027, this is a unique opportunity to join TOMRA during a period of rapid growth and innovation. You'll gain hands-on experience with industry-leading technology, help shape the future of recycling in the UK, and build a rewarding technical career with a company making a positive environmental impact. Qualifications A curious and solution-oriented mindset, with strong attention to detail A customer-focused approach, with clear and confident communication skills A foundation in electro-mechanical systems, with an interest in learning how to analyse, test, and repair complex equipment Comfortable working both independently and as part of a wider, supportive team Flexibility to travel and manage your own schedule in a field-based role Full UK driving licence Additional Information Why TOMRA? Join a global leader committed to innovation and sustainability. At TOMRA, you’ll have the opportunity to make a real impact and contribute to a better future. What do you get from joining TOMRA? A growing UK organisation at an exciting scale‑up stage Purpose‑driven work with real environmental impact Supportive, inclusive and collaborative culture Opportunities to learn, develop and broaden your experience A role where your contribution is visible, valued and you have potential to grow Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package, including: Health insurance (with the option to add family) Employer pension 10% non-contributory pension contributions Tenure Leave (can accrue more leave after from 5+ years of service) Company Bonus Paid overtime Ready to grow your career with purpose? Please apply by sending us your CV, a few words about yourself, and why you are interested in the position and joining TOMRA. Please write this in the field "Message to Hiring Team". Applications are continually assessed so we encourage you to apply at the earliest. TOMRA does not differentiate on the basis of gender, race or ethnicity, religion, colour, sexual orientation or identity, disability, age, or other protected statuses as given by applicable law. We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment and are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. b62dcf53-f9ca-48c0-aeea-39de27c89b8f.description: Photoshop Developer, GPU/Imaging Skip to main content English Sign In Search for Jobs Photoshop Developer, GPU/Imaging page is loaded Photoshop Developer, GPU/Imaging Apply locations San Francisco San Jose Seattle New York time type Full time posted on Posted Yesterday job requisition id R171014 About Adobe At Adobe, we give people the tools to bring their ideas to life. We help creators turn imagination into content that moves the world — and we help businesses turn data into insight and insight into action. We build a culture where people grow as leaders, wherever they sit in the org chart. If you want to do meaningful work inside an open, diverse, and collaborative team, we'd love to meet you. The opportunity Photoshop is 35 years old. Its rendering engine is not. We're rebuilding the core that draws every pixel in Photoshop — replacing decades of accumulated architecture with a modern, GPU-first engine called NGE (NextGen Engine). This is a full rebuild, not an incremental extension, and it unlocks things that weren't possible before: live, non-destructive on-canvas filters, natural media brushing, and image quality built for professional video, film, and VFX work. You'd be joining the team building this engine and bringing it into Photoshop Desktop — a multi-year effort spanning filters, adjustments, layer effects, blend modes, and every existing tool in Photoshop. It's the kind of ground-up rebuild most engineers only get to work on once in a career. What you'll do Design, build, and optimize GPU-based imaging and rendering features using modern C++, WebGPU, and WGSL Write and tune GPU shaders and compute kernels for real-time image processing Profile and optimize performance across the rendering pipeline — GPU occupancy, memory latency, submit batching, and frame time across a range of hardware, from integrated to discrete GPUs Help extend the engine's compositing and color pipeline (blending, color spaces, precision) Write automated tests for the rendering and imaging code you build Use AI tools thoughtfully to speed up development, debugging, and testing Make architectural calls when specs are open-ended or still forming Write clear, self-documenting code that your teammates can easily read and extend Contribute to engineering docs and design reviews, and take part in regular code reviews About you You: Enjoy working close to the hardware — squeezing performance out of GPUs and low-level rendering code Like contributing to something bigger than your own individual output Can make steady progress even when a problem is ambiguous or not fully prioritized yet Bring strong analytical and debugging skills, especially for tricky performance or correctness issues Care about precision and craftsmanship, down to the pixel and the frame Communicate clearly and can distill complex technical tradeoffs for different audiences Stay steady and adaptable when plans shift or setbacks come up Treat challenges as opportunities to learn something new Enjoy solving problems in ways that are both elegant and durable Experience education We're hiring across levels for this role, from early-career through senior, so requirements scale with level: A bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, or equivalent experience in the field Solid grounding in graphics and GPU programming fundamentals — pipelines, shaders, memory and performance tradeoffs Familiarity with GPU hardware architecture across vendors (e.g., integrated vs. discrete GPUs) Experience with one or more graphics APIs, such as Metal, DirectX, Vulkan, or WebGPU Experience building applications in modern C++ (years of experience scale with the level you're hired at) Comfort writing asynchronous, production-quality code A plus, not a requirement: experience with image-processing pipelines, WebAssembly, or large-scale codebases like Photoshop's If you're earlier in your career and don't check every box, we'd still like to hear from you — this role is built to grow engineers into this work, not just hire people who've already done it. Please state your availability and graduation date clearly in your resume. We are building a next-generation enterprise knowledge system for the LLM era. Our goal is to enable large language models to understand, access, and operate on enterprise data, including data warehouses, documents, logs, and real-time streams. This role focuses on designing and researching a unified knowledge layer that supports query, reasoning, and execution, integrating RAG, knowledge graphs, and agent-based systems. Topic Introduction: This project focuses on building a unified knowledge system for the era of large language models. It aims to enable LLMs to efficiently access and understand both structured and unstructured enterprise data, including data warehouses, documents, logs, and real-time information. By integrating Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), knowledge graphs, and agent capabilities, the project seeks to develop an intelligent system that supports querying, reasoning, and execution across key business scenarios such as analytics, decision-making, and automation. Knowledge updates are often delayed, making it difficult to meet real-time requirements. Balancing performance, cost, and latency, while designing a scalable and extensible knowledge integration and orchestration framework, remains a core challenge. 4adedb1c-f646-45c1-873f-d94e442704be.title: Football Tracking Systems Operator - Remote Operations Centre
4adedb1c-f646-45c1-873f-d94e442704be.description: Location: Basingstoke, Hampshire. This is an in-office role, and as such, will require you to live within a reasonable commute. Contract: Casual hourly contract Working Hours: Shifts typically 10 - 12 hours Hourly Rate: £13.00 - £18.20 Per Hour (exact rate will vary depending on role) Start Date: July/August 2026 Why Hawk-Eye Why This Role?: We are looking for candidates to play a key part in delivering Goal Line Technology (GLT) at our centre in Basingstoke; however, there is scope for successful candidates to be offered further opportunities in delivering Electronic Performance and Tracking Systems (EPTS) and Semi-Automatic Offside (SAO) in elite football competitions. Having successfully deployed this system across UEFA competitions, we are now expanding our remote operations to include the Premier League and Championship. Based in the Remote Operations Centre (ROC) at Hawk-Eye’s Head Office in Basingstoke, you'll play a crucial role in operating cutting-edge technology , liaising with Hawk-Eye colleagues on the ground across the UK, and a range of external stakeholders , contributing to the excitement of live sports events. While this is a casual contract, we are seeking candidates with full availability across the week. This role is designed for those looking to commit to significant hours , particularly during peak periods of the football calendar. What Does A Typical Day Look Like? For a typical 3pm kick off you can expect our call time to be 5 to 6 hours prior to the start of the match. Throughout the day you will be faced with several hard deadlines in which you will have to meet in order for the service to run effectively and efficiently. Initially, you will spend the first part of your day testing communications, calibrating, and optimising the technology. This ensures GLT is fully operational two hours prior to kick-off, allowing match officials to test its integrity. Warm up is our final opportunity to ensure the system is fully functional before we enter the live match. During the live match you will be monitoring the data, fine tuning the calibration and constantly preparing to produce a virtual replay for broadcasters should a goal line incident occur and activate our GLT system. To summarise, these would be the key components of the role: Operation of the GLT system from the ROC during matches; Match Day calibration of the GLT system Monitoring of GLT live data Delivering graphics and virtual replays for GLT and which will be shared with the TV audience worldwide Collaborating with supervisors and on-site staff to ensure the system is operated to the highest standard Investigating/troubleshooting software issues as technical support for the on-site team Essential Skills, Attributes, and Requirements: A technical grounding Strong problem-solving skills A willingness to learn Excellent communication skills, punctuality and ability to follow instructions and work towards a shared goal Ability to work flexibly , including weekday evenings and weekends for matches in line with match schedules Live within a commutable distance of the Remote Operating Centre, Basingstoke (RG22) Desirable Attributes: Experience, background or qualification in a technical-related course such as computing, computer science, engineering, mathematics, science or technology. Understanding of PC networks and data collection Camera optimisation At Hawk-Eye Innovations, we appreciate and value the importance of potential and growth. If you believe that you excel in certain areas and possess the passion and desire to develop further, we encourage you to apply. Availability and Training: Please Note: While this is a casual contract, matches take place strictly according to the football calendar. The journey will begin with training and testing during global sporting events from July and into August. It is crucial that you are able to provide a good level of availability to regularly contribute and participate in these exposure and training opportunities over the initial training period. The ultimate goal is that by the opening weekend of the Premier League in August we will have a pool of operators who are ready to deliver GLT across multiple competitions. This role will have an initial focus on UEFA Football events while you train and gain experience in operating our system, with successful candidates then being given further exposure during our EPL and EFL operations. A typical shift would start 6 hours before the designated kick-off time to set up and test technology. The end of the shift is dependent on service, but typically would be 1 or 2 hours after the match has finished. What Difficulties Might I Face? Up to this point, while there may be many things that you find intriguing about this role, the difficulties you may face should not be ignored. Working Hours : Due to the nature of the sports industry, there is often work on weekends and midweek evenings, and we are expected to fulfil our roles until the final whistle and takedown is complete. High-Pressure Situations: Working in a live broadcast environment on a production that is distributed to millions worldwide will bring high levels of pressure. We will do our best to train and equip you to the best possible level to help with these, however it is important to consider how you naturally navigate high-pressure environments, and whether this fast-paced role is the right fit for you. Team Culture At Hawk-Eye, we pride ourselves on a collaborative, high-performance culture where trust, passion, and innovation thrive. We believe in fostering an environment where every team member is empowered to push boundaries and contribute to the future of sports technology. Our work is guided by three core values: We are Brave: We challenge the status quo, embrace big ideas, and constantly seek new ways to innovate in the sports entertainment industry. We aren't afraid to take risks in pursuit of excellence. We are Owners: We take personal accountability for o

manual:c9edc1ad6187.description: About Mach Industries Founded in 2023, Mach Industries is a rapidly growing defense technology company focused on developing next-generation autonomous defense platforms . At the core of our mission is the commitment to delivering scalable, decentralized defense systems that enhance the strategic capabilities of the United States and its allies. With a workforce of approximately 350 employees , we operate with startup agility and ambition. Our vision is to redefine the future of warfare through cutting-edge manufacturing, innovation at speed, and unwavering focus on national security. We are dedicated to solving the next generation of warfare with lethal systems that deter kinetic conflict and protect global security. The Role Mach Industries is seeking a New Grad Software Engineer to join our team in developing the software that powers our autonomous defense systems. You will design, build, and optimize mission-critical software , working across real-time systems, embedded platforms, and autonomy applications. This role demands strong technical fundamentals, adaptability, and ownership , as you will work closely with engineers across software, GNC, embedded systems, and hardware to build and deploy high-performance systems in a fast-paced environment. Key Responsibilities Develop, test, and maintain software for autonomous defense platforms, with a focus on performance, reliability, and scalability. Design and implement clean, efficient, and well-tested code in C++, Rust, Python, or C. Develop software across the stack, from low-level embedded software and firmware to higher-level autonomy and mission applications. Work closely with GNC, embedded, systems, and hardware engineers to integrate software with complex electromechanical systems. Optimize software for real-time execution, low-latency performance, and resource-constrained embedded platforms. Build simulation, testing, and development infrastructure to accelerate software development and validate system performance. Debug and troubleshoot complex software and hardware-software integration issues. Develop automated tests and contribute to CI/CD pipelines to improve software quality and development velocity. Contribute to software architecture and technical design decisions as systems evolve. Identify opportunities to improve system performance, reliability, and developer productivity, and drive solutions from concept through implementation. manual:ed3d909c4d48.description: Uniswap Labs is a core contributor to the Uniswap Protocol, the world's largest DEX, with over $4 trillion in volume across 17 chains. It builds products that help millions access the protocol, including the Uniswap Web App, Wallet, and Trading API. Uniswap Labs is also the primary technical provider for Unichain, a DeFi-native Ethereum Layer 2 built to be the home for liquidity across chains. When you join Uniswap, you become part of a team that's reshaping the way value flows on the internet. We're hiring our first new-grad engineering cohort. Almost nobody in crypto hires and develops early-career engineers in a structured way — we're going to. You'll join one of our engineering pods, ship production code in your first weeks, and be paired with a dedicated senior engineer who owns your growth. We shape engineers full-stack from the start: you won't be boxed into one layer of the stack, and where you land long-term will follow your strengths. What you'll do Ship well-tested production code used by millions — across web, backend services, infrastructure, and (if it's your thing) smart contracts Work side-by-side with your assigned senior mentor and pod: pairing, code review, and real ownership rather than a training track Move across parts of the stack as you grow — we care that you learn to build complete products, not just components Work in person with the team at our NYC headquarters, 5 days a week What we look for A degree in Computer Science or a related field completed (or completing) between December 2024 and September 2026 Evidence that you build: internships, shipped side projects, open-source contributions, hackathon results — include links (GitHub, live apps, write-ups) Strong CS fundamentals and the ability to pick up new languages and systems quickly Genuine excitement about crypto and DeFi — no prior crypto experience required Able to work from our New York office 5 days per week Nice to have Anything you've built on or around crypto — a contract, a bot, a dashboard, a hackathon project Depth in whatever tools you build with — we don't screen for a specific language or framework, and we'd rather see one thing you've built deeply than a keyword list Competitive programming, CTFs, research, or open-source work Love for unicorns :) Minimum full-time salary of $138,400–$198,000. Disclosure in accordance with New York City's Pay Transparency Law. Full Time employees at Uniswap Labs are also eligible for other compensation elements, including tokens, and benefits, dependent on the position type. Uniswap Labs' Full-Time employee benefits include company-paid medical, dental, vision for you and your dependents, wellness offerings including a partnership with Equinox Fitness Clubs, 401(k) with 4% employer contribution, annual $1,500 education stipend, unlimited and encouraged time off, up to 16 weeks paid parental leave, home office setup stipend for remote employees and daily lunches at NY headquarters (all benefits are subject to applicable taxes and based on eligibility). Uniswap Labs is committed to diversity in our workforce and is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer (EEO). We provide employment opportunities without regard to age, race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, disability (including gender dysphoria and similar gender-related conditions), sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation (including actual or perceived heterosexuality, homosexuality, bisexuality, and asexuality), veteran status, military status, domestic violence victim status, reproductive health decision making or any other protected category. manual:ed3d909c4d48.fit_reason: Comp, tier, and NYC location are excellent fits, but the posting hard-gates on a degree completed between December 2024 and September 2026 while the candidate graduates May 2027, making him ineligible for this cohort; the role is also full-stack/web-leaning rather than backend/distributed-systems focused.

Are you ready to explore the world of aerospace and defense? Do you want to learn from and collaborate with some of the greatest minds in the industry? At RTX, our internships, co-ops and full-time careers provide an exceptional foundation to work on complex problems, advance your skills and create a safer, more connected world. What You Will Do You will perform full life-cycle software development including designing system and software solutions; supporting implementation, integration, acceptance testing and deployment. You will contribute to highly technical software engineering teams on challenging software upgrades and features. You will provide analysis for the decomposition of technical system level requirements into sub-system software requirements and design. You will support a large-scale global aviation network infrastructure with heavy design focus in redundancy, high availability, and security. You will develop software for air-ground/ground-ground communication, positional data processing, transport/routing/link layer protocols, and remote deployment capabilities. You will collaborate closely with system engineering/performance, network engineering, system acceptance and field operation teams. You will provide support for product deployment, field monitoring, troubleshooting and operator trainings. You will participate in lab/field integration, Air Navigation Service Providers (ANSPs) from domestic US, South America, Europe and Asia. You will utilize a mature ISO/SEI CMMI compliant process to produce all work products. You will support project leadership, project planning, execution, monitoring and closure activities. You will be working collaboratively onsite in our Annapolis, MD facility. What You Will Learn You will learn how to design solutions and lead innovative software systems that will drive the next generation of growth for the aviation industry. You will learn the aviation market and how communication systems are critical to airline operations. You will grow your professional skills by being trained on ACARS and ATN in which Air Traffic Control (ATC) and Aeronautical Operational Control (AOC) messages. Qualifications You Must Have Bachelor’s degree in Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics (STEM) major obtained by start date. Qualifications We Prefer Knowledge of the commercial aviation industry. Linux, Network Protocols, High Availability and Security. The ideal candidate will have experience using disciplined development processes in a team environment. Aerospace knowledge and experience. Proven communication and collaboration skills to work across internal and external customers (government and commercial). What We Offer Our values drive our actions, behaviors, and performance with a vision for a safer, more connected world. Explainable AI - Postdoctoral Researcher Full-time Organization: Computing Category: Postdoctoral/Fellowship Employee Referral Bonus: Not applicable Job Code 1: PDS.1 Post-Dr Research Staff 1 Pre-Employment Drug Test: Required for external applicant(s) selected for this position (includes testing for use of marijuana) Pre-Placement Medical Exam: Not applicable Security Clearance: None/Position does not require US citizenship (assignments longer than 179 days require a federal background investigation) Position Type: Post Doctoral Company Description Join us and make YOUR mark on the World! Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory (LLNL) has turned bold ideas into world-changing impact advancing science and technology to strengthen U.S. security and promote global stability. Our mission spans four critical national security areas nuclear deterrence, threat preparedness, energy security, and multi-domain defense empowering teams to take on the toughest challenges of today and tomorrow. With a culture built on innovation and operational excellence, LLNL is a place where your expertise can make a real impact. Job Description We have an opening for a Postdoctoral Researcher in Explainable AI to contribute to fundamental R D on understanding what modern AI models learn and how that knowledge is represented internally. As foundation models and deep surrogates inform consequential scientific and national security decisions, domain experts need to inspect, validate, and steer model internals, making interpretability as much a human-AI collaboration problem as a modeling one. Your work will focus on recovering human-meaningful structure from learned representations, including sparse decompositions of activations, concept discovery, mechanistic analysis, and causal intervention, and on the interactive interfaces and evaluation methodology that let experts interrogate that structure and the given explanations. Applications area includes but not limited to multimodal SciML models and deep surrogates for various simulations. This position will be in the Machine Intelligence Group in the Center for Applied Scientific Computing (CASC) Division within the LLNL Computing Directorate. This position offers a hybrid schedule, blending in-person and virtual presence. You will have the flexibility to work from home one or more days per week. Essential Duties Develop and evaluate methods for interpreting the internal representations of deep models, including sparse decompositions of activations, concept extraction, and representation steering. Design human-in-the-loop workflows that let domain experts explore, validate, and correct discovered concepts, and evaluate those workflows with real users. Establish rigorous evaluation methodology for interpretability claims, i.e., faithfulness, stability, and causal grounding. Research, design, implement, and apply advanced machine learning methods for multiple applications in a collaborative scientific environment. Conduct cutting-edge machine learning research effectively and independently. Actively participate with project scientists and engineers in defining, planning, and formulating experimental, modeling, and simulation efforts for complex problems stemming from national security applications. Propose and implement advanced analysis methodologies, collect and analyze data, and document results in technical reports and peer-reviewed publications. Contribute to grant proposals and collaborate with others in a multidisciplinary team environment, including academic and industrial partners, to accomplish research goals. Pursue independent (but complementary) research interests and interact with a broad spectrum of scientists internal and external to the Laboratory. Perform other duties as assigned. Qualifications Recent Ph.D. in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, Human-Computer Interaction, or a related field. In-depth knowledge in explainable AI and related topics, demonstrate relevant experiences and corresponding publications. Demonstrated research experience in explainable or interpretable AI, representation learning, mechanistic interpretability, concept-based explanation, or visual analytics for machine learning. Experience developing and applying deep learning methods at medium to large scale using modern libraries such as PyTorch or JAX. Demonstrated research productivity, as documented by publications, reports, presentations, and/or open-source software in relevant venues (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, CVPR, ACL, IEEE VIS, CHI, JMLR, etc.). Experience with scientific programming in the Python ecosystem, and demonstrated ability to obtain substantial domain knowledge in fields of application in order to communicate effectively with subject matter experts. Desired Qualifications Experience with sparse autoencoders, transcoders, or related feature-learning methods applied to the activations of large pretrained models. Experience analyzing or intervening on the internal representations of trained models, such as probing for encoded properties, steering or editing activations to alter behavior, or attributing outputs to internal components. Experience connecting interpretability to uncertainty quantification, robustness, calibration, or AI safety and assurance evaluation. Experience with high-performance computing, GPU programming, parallel programming, cloud computing, and/or related methods including running numerical simulations of complex workflows. Demonstrated technical leadership in fields related to machine learning, such as mentorship or managing teams. Experience or interest in scientific applications, such as, material science, climate sc

9eeb571e-079e-492d-84f7-49d9ddf5a00d.description: <div class= content-intro ><p><strong>ABOUT ROCKET LAB</strong></p> <p>Rocket Lab is an end-to-end space company delivering responsive launch services, complete spacecraft design and manufacturing, payloads, satellite components, and more – all with the goal of opening access to space. The rockets and satellites we build and launch enable some of the most ambitious and vital space missions globally, supporting scientific exploration, Earth observation and missions to combat climate change, national security, and exciting new technology demonstrations. nbsp; nbsp;</p> <p>Our Electron rocket nbsp;has become the second most frequently launched U.S. rocket annually and has delivered more than 230 satellites to orbit, all while we work to develop Neutron, our upcoming medium-lift, reusable launch vehicle for larger constellation deployment. Our Space Systems business designs and builds our extensive line of satellites, payloads, and their components, including spacecraft that have been selected to support NASA missions to the Moon and Mars and components used on the James Webb Space Telescope. nbsp;</p> <div style= padding: 56.25% 0 0 0; position: relative; ><iframe style= position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; src= https://player.vimeo.com/video/1028198769?h=22add6027e amp;badge=0 amp;autopause=0 amp;player_id=0 amp;app_id=58479 width= height= ></iframe></div></div><p><strong>SPACE SYSTEMS</strong></p> <p>At Rocket Lab, we’re not just launching rockets — we re building the future of space. Our Space Systems team builds everything from complete spacecraft, precision payloads to the components and subsystems that allow them to thrive in space, like solar panels, flight software, star trackers, optical systems, separation systems, radios, and more.</p> <p>Our Space Systems team has enabled more than 1,700 missions, ranging from interplanetary exploration, in-space manufacturing to national security and defense initiatives. The team has built spacecraft, payloads, and components for missions to the Moon and Mars, working with partners including NASA, the Space Development Agency, and the U.S. Space Force. Whether it’s a single high-performance spacecraft, constellation, or the vertically integrated components that help them get to space — our world class Space Systems team is empowering some of the boldest and most ambitious space missions. nbsp;</p> <div> <p><strong>FLIGHT SOFTWARE ENGINEER I nbsp;</strong></p> <p>We are currently seeking a<strong> Flight Software Engineer I</strong> nbsp;for our team based out our Littleton, CO site. In this role, you will play a key role in supporting the development of flight software for our Space Systems programs. You’ll spend your days participating in all aspects of software design and development, from requirements definition through coding and testing. And when we say test, we mean your software will be on orbit within weeks and months, not years. Thanks to having our own rockets and launch sites, we have frequent opportunities to test and operate our software on orbit. To be successful in this role, you must want to see your software make a big impact on the way we explore space and use it as a platform for discovery and innovation. Join a driven team of pioneers relentlessly tackling challenging projects, delivering on the impossible, and making an impact on the future of space!</p> </div> <p><strong>WHAT YOU’LL GET TO DO: nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li>Develop application software to run within a Real Time Operating System (RTOS) and/or embedded Linux</li> <li>Develop hardware drivers to interface to Inertial Measurement Units (IMUs), Star Trackers, Reaction Wheels and other spacecraft sensors and actuators</li> <li>Develop and maintain comprehensive unit tests to run within a Continuous Integration framework</li> <li>Collaborate with hardware-in-the-loop test engineers to verify and validate combined software and hardware functionality</li> <li>Collaborate with systems engineers and embedded systems engineers in developing, documenting and validating requirements</li> <li>Participate in review of source code changes and ensure all changes meet company coding standards</li> <li>Participate in design reviews such as a PDR and CDR</li> <li>Assist with on-orbit (and interplanetary!) flight operations</li> </ul> <p><strong>YOU’LL BRING THESE QUALIFICATIONS AS FLIGHT SOFTWARE ENGINEER I:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor s degree in aerospace engineering, computer science, electrical engineering, or equivalent technical degree</li> <li>Experience in embedded software development</li> <li>Proficiency in C and C++ languages nbsp;</li> <li>Experience with Real Time Operating Systems (RTOS) or with Embedded Linux</li> <li>U.S. citizenship is required, due to program requirements</li> </ul> <p><strong>THESE QUALIFICATIONS WOULD BE NICE TO HAVE:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Active Secret or <span data-teams= true >TS/SCI security clearance</span></li> <li>Advanced Degree</li> <li>Experience developing software and drivers with CAN/CAN-FD and/or UDP/TCP within an embedded system</li> <li>Experience developing software for autonomous vehicles operating in harsh environments, such as Collaborate with customers and cross-functional teams to identify and resolve technical challenges. Analyze system performance and verify compliance with engineering, safety, and quality requirements. Complete technical documentation, service reports, work orders, and project handovers accurately and on time. Support continuous improvement initiatives and provide guidance to less experienced team members when appropriate. Would you like to advance your ideas from concept to prototype to field testing on US military ships, aircraft, satellites, and ground systems? Would you enjoy developing advanced capabilities that will be used by US military personnel to achieve their missions in Intelligence, Surveillance, Reconnaissance, and Targeting? If so, and if you are graduating with a Doctorate degree in a technical field, we'd love to have you join our team at APL! We are seeking creative engineers, scientists, mathematicians, and programmers to help us conceptualize, develop, test, assess, and field the next generation of ISRT and Counter-ISRT capabilities for the US military. Our team applies disciplines such as sensor and data fusion, signal and image processing, operations research, applied physics, machine learning, and artificial intelligence to build systems that automatically or autonomously orchestrate sensors, process data into information, and make intelligent inferences and predictions about complex threats and environments. Our work enables the US military to neutralize a wider variety of serious threats from safer distances than they could otherwise accomplish; improves the safety, survivability, and effectiveness of US air, naval, and ground forces; and disrupts the ability of potential adversaries to threaten our forces. You will lead and contribute to teams developing new modeling, simulation, and analytical methods and tools. You will lead and contribute to teams developing and analyzing new ISRT concepts and architectures. You will lead and contribute to field tests and experiments, including planning, execution, and data analysis. You will document and present your and the team’s results to project leads, sponsors, and technical workshops and conferences. Qualifications You meet our minimum qualifications for the job if you... Have strong inter-personal and written communications skills. Have the ability to work in a team environment. Have the ability to multi-task, support multiple, concurrent projects, and adapt to changing circumstances. Are willing and able to work a portion of the time in secure, closed areas and travel occasionally to government sites and contractor facilities (local and non-local). Are able to obtain a Top Secret /SCI level security clearance. Eligibility requirements include U.S. citizenship. You'll go above and beyond our minimum requirements if you... Are you excited about working on multi-disciplinary teams to innovate the state-of-the-art in autonomous systems, artificial intelligence, software design, embedded systems, virtual reality, simulation and/or uncrewed air platforms? Are you interested in applying your skills to conceive, design, prototype and test new capabilities in intelligent autonomous systems that will save US warfighter’s lives? If you are graduating with a PhD in Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics (STEM) related area and you answered “yes” to any of these questions, we are looking for someone like you to join our team in the Intelligent Combat Platforms Group at APL! All candidates with a strong technical background, high initiative, and the ability to think creatively are encouraged to apply with or without AI experience. Who are we? Whether it is developing the intelligence that drives AI wingmen behaviors, sophisticated real-time collaboration architectures, or novel AI assessment tools and software, the Intelligent Combat Platforms Group is at the forefront. Three of our monumental and impactful projects have been DARPA Air Combat Evolution, AFRL Golden Horde, and Air Force SkyBorg. Prototype and simulate AI systems by writing code, developing software (simulation and visualization), creating algorithms, interfacing software/hardware, and supporting real-time demonstrations of autonomy in live, virtual, and simulation test environments. Collaborate with the nation’s leading experts in AI and work with an outstanding team of engineers, scientists, and software developers to deliver powerful capabilities to the warfighter. Have classroom or professional experience with artificial intelligence and autonomy algorithms. Ranking number one in private brand and contract manufactured salty snacks, as well as the number two supplier of private brand cookies and crackers in North America, you love our products, although you may not be familiar with our name! Responsibilities EDI Business Systems Analyst Massillon, OH (Hybrid Schedule) This position is responsible for designing, implementing, and monitoring our electronic data interchange systems which include documenting and improving business processes, supporting software data exchanges within the organization and externally to our customers. Business Systems Analysts readily see the overall business picture and deal with undefined situations holistically. They perform their role with a structured approach to analysis and problem solving. An electronic data interchange (EDI) analyst facilitates the exchange of electronic data within a company or between two entities by exchanging data for orders, invoices, inventory and shipping documents. This position is ideal for those who love to solve problems and work with computers. This position will work full-time in an office environment but often interact with other departments, customers, or project team members. Your seat at the table: Meeting with customers to discuss their data interchange needs. Analyzing business systems and data interchanges required Translating business requirements into technical solutions Building customized data interchange systems for cross-company or department use. Testing and debugging the system. Gathering user feedback on the accuracy, efficiency, and functionality of the system. Adjusting and customizing the system based on user feedback. Deploying completed systems and providing maintenance support. Training end-users on the proper use of the system. Qualifications What you bring to the table: Bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology, or a similar field. 0-3 years of experience in EDI, business systems analysis, or a related technical role. Knowledge in software programming and coding languages including XML, CSV, and SQL. Analytical thinking and troubleshooting skills. Experience with SQL Server and capability to design SQL queries Ability to project manage and work with large teams. Good communication and interpersonal skills. Serve as the project-embedded liaison to the InfraLink software group: author technical requirements, participate in solution testing, and support deployment of software improvements to your projects. Experience with enterprise systems including CMMS (e.g., Maximo), Work Order management, or ERP platforms (e.g., SAP, Oracle); understanding of how these systems support operational workflows. Adv

This role is an excellent opportunity for an early-career engineer to work on next generation technologies that are part of AMD’s products powering Servers, Datacenters, Client and Embedded markets. Northrop Grumman Aeronautic Systems is seeking a Structural Analysis Engineer (Level 2 or 3) to join our diverse team in Palmdale, CA . This position is for the 2nd shift with a 4/10 (Monday - Thursday) work schedule . The primary role involves conducting structural MRB stress analysis in a fast-paced production environment. We are looking for an engineer who can analyze, research, and develop structural engineering specifications for metals, non-metallic materials, and composite structures in production. Responsibilities include analyzing damage tolerance and durability of metal and composite airframe structures, as well as performing random vibration analysis using tools such as FEMAP, Nastran, Catia, NX and other software applications. This position can be filled at either the Engineer or Principal Engineer level. Basic qualifications for a Principal Structural Analysis Engineer include a Bachelor's in Science, Technology, Engineering or Math (STEM) and at least 5 years of relevant experience, a Master's Degree in STEM with 3 years of relevant experience, or a PhD Degree with no experience. This position requires a current in-scope (within 6 years) DOD Secret Clearance as well as the ability to obtain Program Special access within a reasonable period of time, as determined by the company to meet its business needs. Experience in Bonded Composite Structural Analysis of primary and secondary aircraft structures. Experience in Structural Analysis Methods and documentation, including hand-sheet analysis, as well as the development and manipulation of large Finite Element Models. Preferred Qualifications: Current DoD Secret or Top Secret Clearance. Experience with Special Access Programs. Familiarity with PATRAN or FEMAP. Experience working on military aircraft. Knowledge of MIL-STD regulations as they pertain to aerospace structures. We expect our engineers to close the feedback loop between software design and real-world performance. In this role, your software will have a meaningful and measurable impact on the world.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Develop highly reliable, real-time software.</li> <li>Participate in and lead architecture, design, and code reviews.</li> <li>Develop prototypes and manage experiments to prove out key design concepts.</li> <li>Collaborate with other engineers, from other engineering disciplines, to plan and organize the development of our products.</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, math, or other STEM discipline.</li> <li>Professional development experience in C, C++, Python, C# or another object oriented language (internship experience is applicable).</li> <li>Graduating in the class of 2026 or 2027.</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Strong professional/project experience writing software in a production environment.</li> <li>Developed, debugged and deployed software that has been used in real world applications/projects.</li> <li>Creative approach to problem solving, exceptional analytical skills and engineering fundamentals.</li> <li>Excellent communication skills both written and verbal.</li> <li>Ability to work effectively in a dynamic environment with changing needs and requirements.</li> <li>Experience with networking protocols (UDP, TCP/IP, etc) and distributed systems.</li> <li>Experience in security issues associated with distributed systems and internet services.</li> </ul> <p><strong>ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Must be willing to work extended hours and weekends as needed.</li> </ul> <p> nbsp;</p> <p><strong>COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:</strong><br><br>Pay Range:<br>Level 1: $135,000.00 - $175,000.00<br>Level 2: $155,000.00 - $210,000.00<br><br></p> <p>Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.</p> <p>Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. You may also accrue 3 weeks of paid vacation and will be eligible for 10 or more paid holidays per year. Employees accrue paid sick leave pursuant to Company policy which satisfies or exceeds the accrual, carryover, and use requirements of the law.</p><div class= content-conclusion ><p><strong>ITAR REQUIREMENTS:</strong&
0e79e8bc-db11-456f-97e4-54fea42c6715.fit_reason: Starlink explicitly seeks distributed systems, networking protocols, and distributed-systems security experience — a direct hit on the candidate's Rust Raft/LSM/MVCC KV store and systems/security concentration — and the posting accepts class of 2027 grads; only mild drags are the C/C++/C# language framing, some sub-teams being firmware/RF-centric, ITAR US-person gating, and the explicit extended-hours/weekends requirement.
0e79e8bc-db11-456f-97e4-54fea42c6715.tc_basis: Posting lists Level 1 base of $135k-$175k (new grads almost always L1, realistically $140-155k base in Palo Alto). Add SpaceX long-term incentives (private company stock or long-term cash awards), discretionary bonus, and ESPP discount. SpaceX base pay is competitive with big tech, but equity is illiquid private stock realized only via periodic tender offers, so effective annual TC lands below comparable public-company new-grad offers. Estimate, not fact.

Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><span data-ogsc= rgb(0, 0, 0) ><strong>NEW GRADUATE ENGINEER, SILICON ENGINEERING</strong></span></p> <p><span data-ogsc= rgb(0, 0, 0) >Are you an engineering student graduating in fall or this upcoming spring/summer that is looking for full-time employment after graduation? We are looking for engineers to help us develop next generation silicon for SpaceX. The team is hiring engineers from pre-silicon through post-silicon across many disciplines in RF/Analog IC, RTL design, design verification, physical design, DFT, validation and more using state-of-the-art tools and methodologies. The ideal candidate will be a hands-on self-starter who can execute the steps required to fully design and verify complex designs.</span></p> <p><span data-ogsc= rgb(0, 0, 0) >Full-time employment is a537c9a6-baac-4468-9e36-ec8c0bea98ec.fit_reason: Pure silicon/ASIC/RFIC/physical-design role requiring hands-on ASIC/SOC/FPGA/RFIC and SystemVerilog experience — squarely the hardware/EE-centric profile the candidate lists as low fit, with only incidental C/C++/Python scripting overlap.
a537c9a6-baac-4468-9e36-ec8c0bea98ec.tc_basis: Posting discloses base bands (L1 $135-175k, L2 $155-210k); SpaceX adds illiquid private equity plus a small bonus, so new-grad L1 TC realistically ~$150-190k and L2/top-of-band offers ~$200k+. Comp is well above the $130k anchor; ITAR US-person requirement (citizen/green card) may be a gating constraint.

690c397c-b387-4787-a4e9-78adb2342b32.title: Systems Analyst - Leap Program
690c397c-b387-4787-a4e9-78adb2342b32.description: July 2027 - Leap Systems Analyst Skip to main content Sign In Fidelity Careers July 2027 - Leap Systems Analyst page is loaded July 2027 - Leap Systems Analyst Apply locations Westlake, TX Durham, NC Merrimack, NH time type Full time posted on Posted Yesterday job requisition id 2133879 Job Description: Fidelity Leap Program Note: Fidelity will not provide immigration sponsorship for this position Launch your tech career by building real solutions that impact millions. Ready to go beyond the classroom? Build technology that powers financial outcomes for millions of customers — supporting individuals, employers, and institutions across a global, diversified business with trillions in assets. Join Fidelity’s Leap Program and start your career alongside thousands of technologists shaping the future of financial services. About the Leap Program Our 10-week immersive program is designed to help you transition from college to a full-time technology career. You’ll gain hands-on experience, build production-ready skills, and grow alongside a cohort of peers, all while solving real, complex business challenges. What you’ll gain: Real-world technology experience from day one Mentorship from experienced engineers and leaders A strong peer network that lasts beyond the program A clear path to continued growth at Fidelity Program Highlights Learn by Building Work on real projects in a supportive environment where you can experiment, learn, and make an impact. AI-Native Development Use AI tools as part of your daily workflow, learning how to apply them responsibly to modern engineering challenges. Cohort Experience Join a group of peers in an in-person, team-based setting with built-in support, coaching, and collaboration. Career Acceleration This isn’t just a program, it’s the start of your career. Continue growing with meaningful work, mentorship, and long-term opportunities at Fidelity. The Role We’re looking for curious, driven systems analysts who want to understand how technology and business come together to solve problems and deliver value for customers. In this role, you will: Support analysis activities by participating in stakeholder discussions, capturing requirements, and helping clarify ambiguities with guidance from senior analysts and team members Work on real projects from start to finish, gaining exposure to the full delivery lifecycle including requirements, architecture, design, testing, and implementation Create and maintain documentation such as user stories, functional specifications, acceptance criteria, and process/data flow diagrams using standard tools and templates, while describing basic concepts and major activities associated with requirements analysis Develop an understanding of business context, system workflows, data flows, and upstream/downstream dependencies across the technology landscape Support basic data analysis activities, including running queries, validating test data, and investigating simple data or system issues. while identifying gaps between current systems and future business needs. Assist with testing efforts by creating test cases, executing tests, analyzing results, and logging defects Explore emerging tools and technologies, including AI, and learn how to apply them responsibly to improve analysis and delivery outcomes Contribute as part of a team focused on delivering solutions that help customers achieve their long-term financial goals Skills You Bring To be eligible, applicants must have earned or be on track to earn a bachelor’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, or a related field by the start date. Familiarity with requirements gathering, documentation, or systems analysis concepts (academic or internship experience) Foundational awareness of data concepts (e.g., data flows, data validation, or querying) Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills Ability to break down problems and ask thoughtful, clarifying questions Familiarity with diagramming tools such as Visio or Drawio Hands-on project or internship experience (preferred) Strong written and verbal communication skills Ability to collaborate and thrive in a fast-paced, team environment Curiosity, attention to detail, and a passion for continuous learning Why Fidelity? Work on systems and products used by millions Access to diverse tech stack and AI tools Structured career development and mobility Strong mentorship culture Competitive benefits and stability If you’re excited to learn how technology enables business outcomes and want to build a strong foundation in systems analysis, Fidelity is a great fit for you. We hire for fundamentals, learning agility and problem-solving, and are committed to help you grow. Apply today! Fidelity’s Onsite Working Model Fidelity is transitioning to a full-time onsite working model through a phased rollout across regions and roles. Currently, some roles and locations require 100% onsite presence, while others require less. Onsite expectations are likely to evolve as the rollout continues. This transition does not apply to fully remote roles. Certifications: Category: Information Technology Please be advised that Fidelity’s business is governed by the provisions of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, the Investment Advisers Act of 1940, the Investment Company Act of 1940, ERISA, numerous state laws governing securities, investment and retirement-related financial activities and the rules and regulations of numerous self-regulatory organizations, including FINRA, among others. Those laws and regulations may restrict Fidelity from hiring and/or associating with individuals with certain Criminal Histories.
